description: This Java class, YearStatistics, extends the Statistics class and provides functionality to analyze book data for the current year. It calculates statistics such as least liked, most liked, and average ratings for books read in the current year, based on the date started reading and ratings provided.

classes.name: YearStatistics
classes.description: A class for computing statistics related to books read in the current year, including favorite and least favorite books and average ratings.

methods.name: YearStatistics
methods.description: Constructor initializing the statistics and filtering books read this year.

methods.name: findReadBooksAddedThisYear
methods.description: Filters and returns the list of books read in the current year with ratings.

methods.name: findLeastLikedBookThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the lowest rating read this year, if any.

methods.name: findMostLikedBookThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the highest rating read this year, if any.

methods.name: calculateAverageRatingGivenThisYear
methods.description: Computes the average rating of books read this year.

methods.name: calculateTotalRating
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of ratings for books read this year.
